abstract: We introduce a nonlinear covariance shrinkage method for building optimal portfolios. Our universal portfolio shrinkage approximator (UPSA) is built from closed-form basis portfolios, is cheap to implement, and improves on existing shrinkage methods. Rather than uniformly penalizing all principal components of returns or discarding low-variance ones, UPSA instead reweights components to explicitly optimize expected out-of-sample portfolio performance. In empirical applications using a large cross-section of anomaly factors, it delivers robust improvements over alternative shrinkage methods in the literature.
title: Universal Portfolio Shrinkage
title_zh: 通用投资组合收缩

abstract: This study examines whether CEO behavioural integrity (BI) – the alignment between a CEO’s words and subsequent actions – is associated with corporate credit ratings. Using 8,214 shareholder letters from U.S. public firms over 2013–2023, we construct a hybrid BI index that combines dictionary-based causation measures with FinBERT embeddings, residualized on observable firm, CEO, and narrative-style determinants. We find that higher CEO BI is consistently associated with more favourable credit ratings. This relation is robust across alternative specifications and supplementary analyses, including ordered logit models, entropy balancing, and CEO turnover-based tests, and persists for up to three future periods, albeit with gradually declining strength. Channel analyses suggest two overarching pathways: a stronger information environment – including lower information risk and higher disclosure quality – and reduced managerial opportunism. The relation is more pronounced when financial distress, weak governance, information opacity, CEO risk-taking incentives, or limited rating-agency access make managerial credibility more salient. CEO BI is also associated with lower bond yield spreads, indicating that its information content extends to debt-market pricing. Overall, our findings identify CEO behavioural integrity as a meaningful dimension of managerial credibility that is incorporated into credit assessments and financing outcomes.
title: CEO behavioral integrity and corporate credit ratings: evidence from U.S. Firms
title_zh: CEO行为诚信与企业信用评级：来自美国公司的证据

abstract: Climate, energy, and trade policy uncertainties form a triad that increasingly shapes US economic activity (EAC). This study investigates the association of climate policy uncertainty (CPU), energy-related uncertainty (EUI), and trade policy uncertainty (TPU) with US economic activity. It employs a novel CEEMDAN-based Multivariate Nyström Quantile-on-Quantile Kernel Regularized Least Squares (C-MN-QQKRLS) model, which extends traditional bivariate analysis, incorporates time-frequency asymmetries without absorbing the effects of other pertinent shocks, and addresses computational inefficiencies in conventional kernel designs. Results show that both EUI and TPU are positively associated with EAC in the short term, indicating that economic agents quickly adapt their strategies to changing circumstances. However, in the long term, the uncertainty triad and economic activity are negatively associated at their middle-to-high quantiles, suggesting that long-term uncertainty constrains growth. The persistent negative long-term CPU-EAC, EUI-EAC, and TPU-EAC relationships call for for immediate policy attention. These findings remain robust to macroeconomic controls, alternative variable measures, and nested estimator comparisons. The study highlights the importance of addressing climate-related challenges, achieving a balanced energy mix, and mitigating trade frictions. The evidence indicates that although temporary policy uncertainty shocks produce only short-term effects, persistent or long-term uncertainty imposes a structural constraint on US economic activity.
title: Impact of the uncertainty triad on US economic activity: a multi-resolution quantile machine learning framework
title_zh: 不确定性三元组对美国经济活动的影响：一个多分辨率分位数机器学习框架

abstract: This paper examines whether a place-based artificial intelligence policy improves corporate investment efficiency and whether its effect varies with monetary policy uncertainty and firms’ financial vulnerability. Exploiting the phased rollout of China’s National New Generation Artificial Intelligence Innovation and Development Pilot Zones, we employ a staggered difference-in-differences approach for a panel of Chinese A-share listed firms from 2015 to 2023. We find that the AI pilot-zone policy significantly reduces investment inefficiency, and the reduction is more pronounced among firms with greater short-term refinancing exposure or tighter financing constraints when monetary policy uncertainty is elevated. Using 6.93 million online job postings classified with a fine-tuned MacBERT model, we further show that the policy shifts the composition of AI recruitment towards finance-related vacancies, while overall postings decline. These findings extend evidence on place-based AI policy to corporate capital allocation and highlight the role of financial information-processing capacity in shaping investment efficiency under monetary policy uncertainty.

abstract: This paper examines whether China’s pilot free trade zones (FTZs) promote local artificial intelligence (AI) development. Using panel data for 284 prefecture-level cities from 2008 to 2023, we exploit the staggered rollout of FTZs within a difference-in-differences framework. The results show that FTZ establishment significantly increases the city-year stock of registered AI-related firms. The findings remain robust across alternative DID estimators, placebo and falsification tests, sensitivity analysis for unobserved selection, and alternative functional forms. The results are also positive when granted AI-related patents are used as an alternative outcome. Channel analyses provide suggestive evidence that FTZ establishment is associated with greater labour mobility, improved access to financial resources, stronger entrepreneurial activity, and a more favourable business environment. Heterogeneity analysis shows that the estimated effect is significantly larger in eastern than in central cities and provides suggestive evidence of stronger effects in areas with higher pre-existing marketization.

abstract: Innovation depends on the incentives to create new ideas as well as access to existing ones. Access, in turn, depends on the inherent visibility of an initial invention and on the inventor's decision to disclose it, for example, by patenting. Compared to product innovations, process innovations tend to be less visible, making secrecy as an intellectual property strategy relatively more attractive; and stronger trade secrets protection laws could hamper their disclosure even further. Using exogenous variation in the level of trade secrets protection from the Uniform Trade Secrets Act, we show that stronger protection has a disproportionately negative effect on patenting of processes. We further show in simulations that these changes in disclosure can have large implications for follow‐on innovation and welfare.
title: Visibility of Technology and Cumulative Innovation: Evidence From Trade Secrets Laws
title_zh: 技术的可见性与累积性创新：来自商业秘密法的证据

abstract: This paper shows that high market concentration in the U.S. manufactured home loan market allows lenders to charge markedly higher interest rates than in the mortgage market for site-built homes. Borrowers in counties with higher lender concentration face significantly higher rates, and evidence from bunching at a regulatory rate threshold, an instrumental variable analysis, and a difference-in-differences analysis suggests a causal link. Integrated lenders, which play an outsized role in this market, charge particularly high rates, and we provide evidence suggesting that these lenders exploit their market power over borrowers. We discuss factors that may explain limited lender entry.
title: Affordable Housing, Unaffordable Credit? Concentration and High-Cost Lending for Manufactured Homes
title_zh: 经济适用住房，难以负担的信贷？预制房屋的集中度与高成本贷款

abstract: We highlight the role of duration and exchange rate risks on portfolio flows by using a unique and comprehensive database of U.S. investor flows into emerging market government bonds denominated in local currency. Borrowing long-term mitigates rollover risk but amplifies valuation changes that further interact with currency movements. Our analysis highlights the double-edged nature of long-term borrowing and draws attention to market stress dynamics due to strategic complementarities among mutual fund investors.
title: Original Sin Redux: Role of Duration Risk*
title_zh: 原罪再现：久期风险的作用

abstract: As China's manufacturing industry enters a pivotal phase of high-quality development, accurately assessing its energy efficiency (EE) has become essential for advancing green transformation. However, traditional approaches to measuring EE are prone to distortion from extreme observations, thereby limiting their effectiveness in capturing firm-level EE. Therefore, machine learning (ML) techniques are employed in this study to optimize EE assessment. The primary innovations of this paper are summarized as follows. First, ML-based decision-making units are constructed and introduced into the traditional efficiency evaluation model. Second, EE at the firm level is precisely measured using the proposed model, which improves the reliability of efficiency evaluation. Third, inefficiency is decomposed into internal and external components to identify targeted improvement directions. The empirical analysis based on the panel data of listed manufacturing firms in China yields several key insights. First, the proposed method provides a more rigorous efficiency benchmark and improves the discrimination among efficient firms. Second, firm-level EE exhibits a hierarchical distribution pattern with a small number of highly efficient firms and a large number of relatively low-efficiency firms. Third, EE varies significantly across industries and regions. Fourth, inefficiency mainly originates from either internal or external constraints, indicating heterogeneous improvement directions among firms. Accordingly, a set of differentiated policy recommendations tailored to these firms is proposed to improve their EE.
abstract_zh: 随着中国制造业进入高质量发展的关键阶段，准确评估其能源效率（EE）已成为推进绿色转型的必要条件。然而，传统的能源效率测度方法易受极端观测值扭曲，从而限制了其在捕捉企业层面能源效率方面的有效性。因此，本研究采用机器学习（ML）技术来优化能源效率评估。本文的主要创新点概括如下。第一，构建基于机器学习的决策单元，并将其引入传统效率评价模型。第二，利用所提出的模型精确测度企业层面的能源效率，从而提高效率评价的可靠性。第三，将无效率分解为内部和外部两个组成部分，以识别有针对性的改进方向。基于中国制造业上市公司面板数据的实证分析得出若干关键发现。第一，所提出的方法提供了更严格的效率基准，并提高了对有效率企业之间的区分度。第二，企业层面能源效率呈现分层分布格局，即少数高效率和大量相对低效率企业并存。第三，能源效率在不同行业和地区之间存在显著差异。第四，无效率主要来源于内部或外部约束，表明企业之间的改进方向具有异质性。据此，本文提出一套针对这些企业量身定制的差异化政策建议，以提升其能源效率。

abstract: Replication package for "The Long Shadow of Missing Women on Marriage and Fertility" (Sunha Myong), Economic Modelling. HYPOTHESIS. Sex-selective abortion in South Korea in the 1980s and early 1990s raised the sex ratio at birth from about 1.05 to about 1.15. The hypothesis is that this reduces marriage and, through marriage, fertility with a lag of roughly three decades, as the affected cohorts reach prime marriage age. DATA. Three Statistics Korea microdata products from the Microdata Integrated Service (MDIS, mdis.mods.go.kr): Census 2% samples 2000-2020, marriage registers (B-type) 2001, 2006, 2011, 2016, 2021, and the 2020 birth register. All three are public-use files, downloadable directly by any registered MDIS account without application, approval or fee. Also WDI, UN WPP 2024 and KOSIS tables. Individuals fall into 24 types by education, age band and capital region; the estimation uses, per vintage, the 24x24 matrix of marriages by (husband, wife) type, never-married counts and the implied Choo-Siow surplus. These are included in full. SYNTHETIC DATA. The MDIS licence does not permit redistribution, so the three files are not included; DATA_AVAILABILITY.md documents the download procedure and variable selection. Synthetic replacements are provided instead: artificial records generated to reproduce a dataset's structure while containing none of its records. Each variable was regenerated from a one-way frequency table, so a replacement matches its original in file name, variable names, observation count, missing counts and every distribution. Variables are drawn independently, so each marginal distribution is exact and the joint structure is not. In the 2021 register 78% of college-educated husbands have a college-educated wife; in the synthetic file the figure is 58%, the value implied by independence. That sorting is the object of the estimation; a synthetic run establishes only that the code executes. FINDINGS. Restoring the women missing from the 1980-1995 cohorts, relative to a natural sex ratio of 1.050, raises the 2021 female marriage-market stock by 5.53% and lowers the market sex ratio from 1.243 to 1.178. Re-solving the equilibrium with the surplus held fixed yields 5,008 additional marriages, 3.23% of the 154,890 observed in 2021, and about 8,500 additional births, 3.3% of the 2021 total. The effect is lagged and increasing: 0.86% in 2006, 1.35% in 2011, 2.28% in 2016, 3.23% in 2021. College-educated women aged 25-34 are 42.4% of the restored stock and 74.5% of new marriages. USE. The counterfactual is partial equilibrium: stocks vary while the surplus is held at baseline. Stage 1 (Stata) constructs the 24-type matrices from the microdata; stage 2 (MATLAB) estimates the surplus, solves the counterfactual and produces every table and figure. Because the matrices are included, stage 2 reproduces every published result without microdata. README.md documents the procedure, software versions and exhibit-to-script mapping.
abstract_zh: 本文考察韩国出生性别比失衡的长期后果。20世纪80年代及90年代初的性别选择性堕胎造成了女性持续短缺。本文运用婚姻市场的经济模型，结合人口普查与婚姻数据，量化了若恢复这些缺失女性将如何重塑韩国的婚姻与生育。在反事实情形下，2021年婚姻市场中的女性人口增加5.5%，带来约5000桩额外婚姻，使韩国2021年婚姻数量增加3.2%。这些婚姻转化为2021年婚姻队列中8500例额外终生生育，其规模相当于韩国2021年全国出生人口的3.3%。上述效应集中于年轻且受过大学教育的人群。过去的性别选择性堕胎强加了一个结构性生育下限，任何鼓励生育政策都无法抵消——中国、印度和越南也面临这一约束。弥合当今的性别比失衡将促进下一代的婚姻与生育。

abstract: This paper examines whether green upgrading of existing industrial zones can improve productivity while reducing pollution. We digitize official boundaries for national- and provincial-level development zones in China and match them to geocoded manufacturing establishments from 1998 to 2014. Exploiting staggered approval of 69 Eco-Industrial Parks, we estimate difference-in-differences models comparing firms in treated parks with firms in other development zones. Fixed-effects, matching, reweighting, and heterogeneity-robust event-study estimates show that EIP designation is associated with 6–10% higher total factor productivity, 33–40% lower SO₂ emission intensity, and 34–37% lower smoke emission intensity. The effects are stronger for larger firms, pollution-intensive industries, and eastern regions. Additional evidence points to within-firm adjustment, industrial complementarity, cleaner fuel use, and pollution-control investment. The findings suggest that coordinated green upgrading can improve both economic and environmental performance in established industrial clusters.
abstract_zh: 本文考察现有工业园区绿色升级能否在提高生产率的同时减少污染。我们数字化了中国国家级和省级开发区的官方边界，并将其与1998年至2014年地理编码的制造业企业进行匹配。利用69个生态工业园分批获批的特征，我们估计了双重差分模型，比较受处理园区内企业与其他开发区内企业。固定效应、匹配、重加权以及异质性稳健的事件研究估计表明，生态工业园认定与全要素生产率提高6%—10%、二氧化硫排放强度降低33%—40%、烟尘排放强度降低34%—37%相关。对于规模较大的企业、污染密集型行业和东部地区，效应更强。进一步证据指向企业内部调整、产业互补性、更清洁燃料使用以及污染治理投资。研究结果表明，协同推进绿色升级能够改善成熟产业集群的经济绩效和环境绩效。

abstract: Using exogenous variation generated by the creation of the Single Supervisory Mechanism (SSM) in the euro area, we find that relative to firms borrowing from banks subject to national supervision, firms borrowing from banks subject to supranational supervision reduce their share of intangible assets. This effect does not pre-date the supervisory reform and it does not obtain in non-SSM jurisdictions. The reallocation of investment away from intangible assets is stronger for small and young firms and appears to be driven by a short-term reduction in lending and a persistent increase in collateral standards.
abstract_zh: 利用欧元区单一监管机制（SSM）建立所产生的外生变异，我们发现，相对于从受国家监管的银行借款的企业，从受超国家监管的银行借款的企业会减少其无形资产份额。这一效应在监管改革之前并不存在，且在非SSM司法管辖区中也不成立。投资从无形资产中重新配置的现象在小型和年轻企业中更为显著，并且似乎是由贷款短期减少和抵押品标准的持续提高所驱动。

abstract: This essay argues that the antitrust economics of platforms has moved from asking how platforms compete with one another to asking how competition is organised inside platforms. The older questions about pricing, network effects, tipping, and multi-homing remain necessary but new questions arise. Rankings, defaults, data access, and the design of the interface have become part of the competitive environment rather than the backdrop against which competition happens. They can create value by improving matching, trust, and coordination; they can also allocate attention, weaken outside options, and shift surplus. I organise recent work around this of/in distinction, emphasising the mechanisms through which platform design affects market outcomes and the corresponding implications for evidence, remedies, and institutional capacity. I close by considering AI-mediated markets, where similar questions arise at a less visible layer of choice.
abstract_zh: 本文认为，平台的反垄断经济学已从追问平台之间如何竞争，转向追问竞争如何在平台内部组织起来。关于定价、网络效应、 tipping、多归属等较早的问题仍然必要，但新的问题随之出现。排名、默认设置、数据访问和界面设计已成为竞争环境的一部分，而不再是竞争赖以发生的背景。它们可以通过改善匹配、信任和协调来创造价值；它们也可以分配注意力、削弱外部选择并转移剩余。我围绕这一“of/in”区分来组织近期研究，强调平台设计影响市场结果的机制，以及对证据、救济措施和制度能力相应的含义。最后，我考察AI中介的市场，在那里类似的问题出现在一个更不易察觉的选择层面上。
title: Antitrust and Platforms: From of to in
title_zh: 反垄断与平台：从“的”到“中

abstract: We develop a theory of stakeholder governance examining how green stakeholders influence organizations. Conflicts of interest arise from heterogeneous green preferences and intensify as they diverge. Changes in green preferences can generate unexpected outcomes by shifting control rights: greener stakeholders may reduce organizational sustainability, while browner ones might enhance it. We show that a top-down approach consistently improves organizational sustainability, while a bottom-up approach can harm it. We also uncover an asymmetry in compensation and delegation decisions between green and brown principals, driven by the public good nature of social payoffs. These findings have implications for manager–employee, investor–entrepreneur, and board–CEO relationships.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一种利益相关者治理理论，考察绿色利益相关者如何影响组织。利益冲突源于异质的绿色偏好，并随着偏好分歧的加剧而强化。绿色偏好的变化会通过转移控制权产生出人意料的后果：更绿色的利益相关者可能降低组织可持续性，而更棕色的利益相关者则可能提升组织可持续性。我们表明，自上而下的方法始终能够改善组织可持续性，而自下而上的方法则可能损害组织可持续性。我们还揭示了绿色与棕色委托人在薪酬和授权决策上的一种不对称性，这种不对称性源于社会收益的公共品性质。这些发现对管理者—员工、投资者—创业者以及董事会—CEO关系具有启示意义。
title: Sustainable organizations
title_zh: 可持续组织

abstract: Economists often estimate preferences by looking at how demand for an option changes as its attributes change or as beliefs about them change in response to information. I show in a multi-attribute induced-preference experiment that this method can be substantially biased due to differential inattention. Attention is systematically distorted at baseline, with participants reacting much more to some attributes than others. Further, attention is highly malleable: information telling participants about the value of a desirable attribute—even when the information is already known, transparently redundant, and explicitly randomly assigned—greatly increases attention to the attribute it describes and distracts from other attributes. It also boosts average demand for the good, implying that inattention takes the form of neglect rather than shrinkage toward a prior. These results combine to imply that information experiments with passive control groups can be greatly misleading about preferences and can even have the wrong sign: in my experiment, reducing overoptimism about an attribute nonetheless boosts demand for its associated good. I show, both theoretically and experimentally, that active control-group experiments yield preference estimates with the correct sign but biased magnitudes. Finally I show that parallel active control-group experiments (PACEs) can solve this problem: PACEs yield unbiased estimates of preferences under an equal induced-attention assumption, which is testable (and satisfied) in my experiment.
abstract_zh: 经济学家通常通过观察某一选项的需求如何随其属性变化，或随关于这些属性的信念因信息而变化来估计偏好。我在一个多属性诱导偏好实验中表明，由于差异性不注意，这种方法可能严重偏误。基线状态下注意被系统性扭曲，参与者对某些属性的反应远强于其他属性。此外，注意具有高度可塑性：告知参与者某一合意属性价值的信息——即使该信息已为人知、明显冗余且被明确随机分配——也会大幅增加对其所描述属性的注意，并分散对其他属性的注意。它还会提高对该商品的总体需求，这意味着不注意表现为忽视，而非向先验收缩。这些结果共同表明，带有被动控制组的信息实验可能严重误导对偏好的判断，甚至可能符号相反：在我的实验中，降低对某一属性的过度乐观反而提高了对相关商品的需求。我从理论和实验两方面表明，主动控制组实验产生的偏好估计符号正确，但幅度有偏。最后，我表明平行主动控制组实验（PACEs）可以解决这一问题：在同等诱导注意假设下，PACEs产生无偏的偏好估计，而该假设在我的实验中是可检验的（且得到满足）。
journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
title: Inattention, Information Provision, and (Failures of) Revealed Preference,
title_zh: 注意力不集中、信息提供与（显示性偏好的）失灵

abstract: This paper investigates the extent to which an immigration shock to a region propagates through supply chains. Using the unexpected arrival of Syrian refugees, who are densely concentrated in border regions of Turkey, we estimate how firms across the country are affected in terms of sales, employment, and wages. We also examine the impact of the shock on interprovincial trade, focusing on trade volume and network formation. The results reveal positive spillover effects of immigration for firms with pre-existing links to Syrian refugee-hosting regions through upstream and downstream supply chain connections. Furthermore, we find evidence that the shock expands inter-provincial trade and contributes to the formation of new firm-to-firm linkages between provinces. Finally, we show that traditional spatial approaches that compare regions with differing migration rates may conflate cross-province propagation with the direct effect of migrants; in our setting, this conflation overstates direct effects on sales and employment at both the firm and regional levels of aggregation and masks a negative direct wage effect at the firm level.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了某一地区的移民冲击通过供应链传导的程度。利用叙利亚难民意外涌入且高度集中于土耳其边境地区这一事实，我们估计了全国范围内企业在销售额、就业和工资方面受到的影响。我们还考察了该冲击对省际贸易的影响，重点关注贸易量和网络形成。结果表明，对于与接收叙利亚难民地区通过上游和下游供应链联系已有既有联系的企业而言，移民产生了正向溢出效应。此外，我们发现有证据表明，该冲击扩大了省际贸易，并促进了各省之间新的企业间联系的形成。最后，我们表明，比较具有不同移民率的地区的传统空间方法，可能会将跨省传导与移民的直接影响混为一谈；在我们的情境中，这种混淆高估了在企业层面和区域层面聚合上对销售额和就业的直接影响，并掩盖了企业层面负向的直接工资效应。

abstract: We propose a refinement of correlated equilibrium based on common perturbations of the mediator’s recommendation distribution, which we call correlated perfect equilibrium (CPE). In finite games, the set of CPEs is nonempty and forms a finite union of convex polyhedra. Like perfect equilibrium, a CPE never assigns positive probability to any weakly dominated strategy. We provide a dual representation of CPE, which yields an iterative procedure for identifying CPEs. These perturbations provide a common source of off-equilibrium beliefs, a feature that distinguishes CPE from two existing refinements of correlated equilibrium—acceptable correlated equilibrium (Myerson, 1986) and perfect direct correlated equilibrium (Dhillon and Mertens, 1996)—as we demonstrate through examples.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种基于中介推荐分布的共同扰动对相关均衡的改进，称为相关完美均衡（CPE）。在有限博弈中，CPE集非空且构成有限个凸多面体的并集。与完美均衡一样，CPE从不为任何弱劣策略赋予正概率。我们给出了CPE的对偶表示，由此得到一种识别CPE的迭代方法。这些扰动为偏离均衡信念提供了一个共同来源，这一特征使CPE区别于相关均衡的两种现有改进——可接受相关均衡（Myerson，1986）和完美直接相关均衡（Dhillon和Mertens，1996）——我们通过例子对此加以说明。

abstract: An environmental limit changes the nature of economic growth, but does not preclude it. When atmospheric greenhouse gas levels reach a critical threshold, further economic growth requires a permanently expanding and resource-intensive mitigation effort. If too slow, technical progress in mitigation becomes a constraint and the ultimate determinant of economic growth. Secularly expanding GDP remains a durable feature of this class of economies, however, and characterizes the social planner’s optimum. Our findings are robust to the introduction of directed technical change.
abstract_zh: 环境限制改变了经济增长的性质，但并不排除增长。当地球大气温室气体水平达到临界阈值时，进一步的经济增长要求永久扩大且资源密集型的减排努力。如果减排进展过慢，减排中的技术进步就会成为约束，并最终决定经济增长。然而，在这类经济体中，长期扩张的GDP仍然是一个持久特征，并刻画了社会规划者的最优结果。我们的发现对于引入有方向的技术变迁仍然稳健。
title: Economic Growth and Greenhouse Gas Mitigation at the Environmental Limit
title_zh: 环境极限下的经济增长与温室气体减排

abstract: In the context of a green energy transition, capital adjustment costs render effective substitution between clean and dirty energy sources finite and endogenous, despite infinite long-run substitutability. Ramsey optimal paths robustly frontload clean investment before exhaustion of a given carbon budget, but also generally imply some capital stranding. Along the path of emissions reduction, new investment is quantitatively more important than reduced output or labor redeployment. An ambitious climate goal in our benchmark calibration implies modest levels of stranded capital at 1.5% of GDP, but this rises to more than 7% if implementation is delayed by a decade.
abstract_zh: 在绿色能源转型背景下，资本调整成本使得清洁能源与高碳能源之间的有效替代变得有限且内生化，尽管长期替代弹性为无限大。拉姆齐最优路径稳健地表明，在给定碳预算耗尽之前应提前进行清洁投资，但通常也意味着一定程度的资本搁浅。在减排路径上，新投资在数量上比减少产出或劳动力重新配置更为重要。在我们的基准校准中，一个雄心勃勃的气候目标意味着资本搁浅水平适中，占GDP的1.5%，但如果实施延迟十年，这一比例将上升至7%以上。
title: Capital Adjustment Costs and Stranded Assets in an Optimal Energy Transition
title_zh: 最优能源转型中的资本调整成本与搁浅资产

abstract: The paper examines whether and how high-temperature exposure at domestic suppliers drives downstream firms to increase imports. By combining supplier–customer linkages disclosed by Chinese listed firms (2010–2016) with upstream meteorological data and downstream customs records, we analyze how customer firms adapt to heat shocks transmitted through supply chains. Our findings show that hot weather at supplier locations leads to a significant rise in customer imports, and this effect persists even when suppliers and customers are geographically distant. The results are robust across various samples, model specifications, and temperature measures. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that the response is more pronounced among customer firms with weaker bargaining power or better access to foreign markets. These patterns support an adaptation-based interpretation: supply chain-transmitted heat shocks are sufficiently consequential to induce firms to reallocate input sourcing abroad.
abstract_zh: 本文考察国内供应商的高温暴露是否会以及如何推动下游企业增加进口。通过将中国上市公司（2010—2016年）披露的供应商—客户 linkages 与上游气象数据及下游海关记录相结合，我们分析了客户企业如何适应通过供应链传导的热冲击。研究发现，供应商所在地的高温天气会导致客户进口显著上升，且即使供应商与客户在地理上相距遥远，这一效应依然存在。该结果在不同样本、模型设定和温度度量下均保持稳健。异质性分析表明，这一反应在议价能力较弱或更容易进入国外市场的客户企业中更为明显。这些模式支持一种基于适应的解释：通过供应链传导的热冲击具有足够重要的影响，促使企业将投入品采购重新配置到国外。

abstract: Understanding how heterogeneous cyber risk shapes security investments and contagion is a key challenge for the resilience of interconnected digital systems. Existing studies on cybersecurity investments and network contagion typically rely on homogeneous assets, uniform attack incentives, or non-strategic threat propagation. We develop a Stackelberg security game that combines contagion dynamics with heterogeneous cyber risk, allowing attackers and defenders to assign different values to network nodes, reflecting differences in asset criticality, information, and objectives. We characterize the equilibrium allocation of cybersecurity investments and derive an analytical approximation for the optimal defense strategy based on endogenous network protection metrics. We show that cyber-risk heterogeneity significantly affects attack incentives and resource allocation, while neglecting it leads to systematic defense misallocation. Our results suggest that cybersecurity policies should leverage both actual and perceived differences in node criticality, as cyber-deception mechanisms can create strategic misperceptions that redirect attacks and enhance systemic resilience.
abstract_zh: 理解异质性网络风险如何塑造安全投资与风险传染，是互联数字系统韧性的一个关键挑战。现有关于网络安全投资与网络传染的研究通常依赖于同质资产、统一攻击激励或非策略性威胁传播。我们构建了一个将传染动力学与异质性网络风险相结合的Stackelberg安全博弈，允许攻击者和防御者为网络节点赋予不同价值，以反映资产关键性、信息和目标方面的差异。我们刻画了网络安全投资的均衡配置，并基于内生网络保护指标推导出最优防御策略的解析近似。我们表明，网络风险异质性显著影响攻击激励与资源配置，而忽视它会导致系统性的防御错配。我们的结果表明，网络安全政策应同时利用节点关键性的实际差异与感知差异，因为网络欺骗机制可以制造策略性误判，从而重定向攻击并增强系统韧性。
title: Contagion effects of heterogeneous cyber risk on network security and systemic stability
title_zh: 异质性网络风险对网络安全与系统稳定性的传染效应

abstract: We examine the direct and indirect effects of transparency regulation on economic activity. Using two distinct sources of regulatory variation—the varying extent of financial-reporting requirements and the staggered introduction of electronic business registers in Europe—, we find that direct exposure to transparency regulation tends to hurt focal firms’ economic activity (e.g., production and employment). By contrast, we find that indirect exposure to transparency regulation imposed on other related firms tends to help focal firms’ economic activity. In terms of relative magnitudes, we find that the negative direct and positive indirect effects tend to be of similar size, almost perfectly offsetting each other. Collectively, our evidence suggests that transparency regulation appears to primarily reallocate economic activity from more toward less regulated markets rather than help or hurt aggregate economic activity.
abstract_zh: 我们考察透明度监管对经济活动的直接与间接效应。利用两种不同的监管变异来源——财务报告要求的程度差异以及欧洲电子商业登记册的分阶段引入——我们发现，直接暴露于透明度监管往往会损害焦点企业的经济活动（例如生产和就业）。相比之下，我们发现，由其他关联企业所承受的透明度监管带来的间接暴露，往往有助于焦点企业的经济活动。就相对规模而言，我们发现负向直接效应与正向间接效应往往大小相近，几乎完全相互抵消。总体而言，我们的证据表明，透明度监管似乎主要将经济活动从监管较强的市场重新配置到监管较弱的市场，而非帮助或损害总体经济活动。
title: Direct and Indirect Effects of Transparency Regulation
title_zh: 透明度监管的直接与间接效应

abstract: Generative search is an emerging search paradigm that integrates Generative AI (GenAI) into traditional search engines by presenting users with AI-generated responses before conventional search results. Whereas keyword-based search requires consumers to translate their underlying needs into effective keyword queries, generative search lets users express those intentions directly in natural language, a shift made possible by GenAI’s new mode of information presentation. This shift moves the consumer-search engine interaction upstream to the stage of problem formulation, rendering empirically observable a previously hidden phase of search behavior: the mapping from problem formulation to keyword articulation. Yet, it remains empirically unknown whether generative search increases consumer purchases and how search behavior changes when it can begin from expressed intent rather than keywords. Using a large-scale field experiment conducted on Meituan, a leading Chinese technology platform, this paper provides empirical evidence on the effectiveness of generative search. We find that generative search significantly increases consumer purchases. Further analysis reveals that generative search facilitates more effective and diverse keyword queries and reduces exploratory browsing and clicking, while concentrating evaluation within relevant categories and merchants. The empirical evidence is most consistent with a mechanism in which AI-generated answers provide information about consumers’ underlying needs, while also expanding awareness of relevant attributes and shifting attention toward more relevant categories. These findings provide empirical insights for future consumer search models that allow search to originate at the intention-expressing stage. This paper was accepted by Raphael Thomadsen, marketing. abstract_zh: 生成式搜索是一种新兴的搜索范式，它将生成式人工智能（GenAI）融入传统搜索引擎，在常规搜索结果之前向用户呈现AI生成的回答。基于关键词的搜索要求消费者将其潜在需求转化为有效的关键词查询，而生成式搜索则允许用户直接用自然语言表达这些意图，这一转变之所以成为可能，得益于GenAI全新的信息呈现方式。这一转变将消费者与搜索引擎的交互前移至问题构建阶段，使搜索行为中一个此前隐藏的阶段——从问题构建到关键词表达的映射——变得可实证观察。然而，生成式搜索是否会增加消费者购买，以及当搜索可以从表达的意图而非关键词开始时搜索行为如何变化，在实证上仍属未知。本文利用在中国领先科技平台美团上开展的大规模实地实验，为生成式搜索的有效性提供了实证证据。我们发现，生成式搜索显著增加了消费者购买。进一步分析表明，生成式搜索促进了更有效、更多样的关键词查询，并减少了探索性浏览和点击，同时将评估集中于相关的品类和商家。实证证据与以下机制最为一致：AI生成的回答提供了关于消费者潜在需求的信息，同时扩展了对相关属性的认知，并将注意力转向更相关的品类。这些发现为未来允许搜索从意图表达阶段开始的消费者搜索模型提供了实证洞见。本文由Raphael Thomadsen（市场营销领域）接收。资助：新加坡教育部[Grant A-8001730-00-00]的财务支持谨此致谢。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02458获取。

abstract: This paper provides the relevant literature with a complete toolkit for conducting robust estimation and inference about the parameters of interest involved in a high-dimensional panel data framework. Specifically, (1) we allow for non-Gaussian, serially and cross-sectionally correlated and heteroskedastic error processes, (2) we develop an estimation method for high-dimensional long-run covariance matrix using a thresholded estimator, (3) we also allow for the number of regressors to grow faster than the sample size. Methodologically and technically, we develop two Nagaev--types of concentration inequalities: one for a partial sum and the other for a quadratic form, subject to a set of easily verifiable conditions. Leveraging these two inequalities, we derive a non-asymptotic bound for the LASSO estimator, achieve asymptotic normality via the node-wise LASSO regression, and establish a sharp convergence rate for the thresholded heteroskedasticity and autocorrelation consistent (HAC) estimator. We demonstrate the practical relevance of these theoretical results by investigating a high-dimensional panel data model with interactive effects. Moreover, we conduct extensive numerical studies using simulated and real data examples.
abstract_zh: 本文为相关文献提供了一套完整的工具包，用于在高维面板数据框架下对感兴趣的参数进行稳健估计与推断。具体而言：(1) 我们允许非高斯、序列相关与截面相关以及异方差的误差过程；(2) 我们利用阈值估计量为高维长期协方差矩阵开发了一种估计方法；(3) 我们还允许回归变量数量以快于样本量的速度增长。在方法论与技术层面，我们发展了两类Nagaev型集中不等式：一类针对部分和，另一类针对二次型，且均在一组易于验证的条件下成立。借助这两个不等式，我们推导了LASSO估计量的非渐近界，通过逐节点LASSO回归实现了渐近正态性，并为阈值化异方差与自相关一致（HAC）估计量建立了精确的收敛速率。我们通过研究一个具有交互效应的高维面板数据模型，展示了这些理论结果的实际相关性。此外，我们利用模拟数据和真实数据实例进行了广泛的数值研究。
title: Robust estimation and inference for high-dimensional panel data models
title_zh: 高维面板数据模型的稳健估计与推断

abstract: Cross-border venture capital (CB VC) is widely assumed to accelerate technological diffusion, yet whether it generates knowledge spillovers or primarily reallocates financial capital remains empirically unresolved. Drawing on 13,362 semiconductor VC investment rounds worldwide (1981–2024), from which we identify 3,363 cross-border rounds across roughly 470 investor→target corridors and analyse the 47 corridors with complete covariates, merged with USPTO patent data, this study contrasts two mechanisms: knowledge spillover through technological transfer and capital deepening through market-driven investment dynamics. Investment patterns are shaped by target-country location advantages and, with comparable weight, by investor-country technological capability; that ownership advantage, however, does not translate into recipient-side innovation gains. The raw positive association between CB VC and patenting is not detectable under within-corridor fixed effects and is not restored when innovation is measured across all major patent offices (CNIPA, EPO/WIPO, and others) rather than the USPTO alone. This null holds across patent counts, technological breadth, and citation impact: the estimates rule out average effects larger than roughly 0.10 log points while remaining compatible with smaller ones, a pattern consistent with absorptive-capacity constraints in knowledge assimilation. Firm-level patterns are consistent with investor selection, although cross-sectional firm data cannot by themselves exclude localized micro-level spillovers, and moderation analyses find no robust absorptive-capacity threshold above which spillovers emerge—though the small number of highly capable treated recipients leaves that test underpowered. Industrial-policy shocks are followed by gains in domestic semiconductor patenting—most robustly in the number of patenting firms—with no detectable moderation by CB VC, while cross-border deal activity is strongly persistent, driven primarily by returning and previously connected investors rather than first-time entrants: a pattern consistent with financial-market network dynamics, not technological diffusion. These findings reframe the function of CB VC from knowledge transfer to capital allocation. The study contributes to research on technological change in global innovation systems and offers policy implications, confined to the technology-diffusion channel, for the governance of frontier technologies.
abstract_zh: 跨境风险投资（CB VC）被广泛认为能够加速技术扩散，但其究竟产生知识溢出，还是主要进行金融资本再配置，在实证上仍未得到解决。本研究基于全球13,362笔半导体风险投资轮次（1981—2024年），从中识别出约470条投资者→目标企业走廊中的3,363笔跨境投资轮次，并分析了其中协变量完整的47条走廊，同时合并USPTO专利数据，对比了两种机制：通过技术转移实现的知识溢出，以及通过市场驱动投资动态实现的资本深化。投资模式受目标国区位优势塑造，并且投资者国技术能力具有与之相当的权重；然而，这种所有权优势并未转化为接收方的创新收益。CB VC与专利产出之间原始的正相关关系，在走廊内固定效应下无法被检测到，并且当创新以所有主要专利局（CNIPA、EPO/WIPO及其他）而非仅USPTO来衡量时，这一关系也未恢复。这一零结果在专利数量、技术广度和引用影响上均成立：估计排除了平均效应大于约0.10个对数点的可能性，同时仍与更小的效应相容，这一模式与知识吸收中的吸收能力约束相一致。企业层面模式与投资者选择相一致，尽管横截面企业数据本身无法排除局部微观层面的溢出，并且调节分析未发现溢出得以出现的稳健吸收能力阈值——不过高能力受处理接收方数量较少，使该检验功效不足。产业政策冲击之后，国内半导体专利产出出现增长——最稳健地体现在专利企业数量上——且未检测到CB VC的调节作用，而跨境交易活动具有强烈持续性，主要由回流投资者和先前已有联系的投资者驱动，而非首次进入者：这一模式与金融市场网络动态相一致，而非技术扩散。这些发现将CB VC的功能从知识转移重新界定为资本配置。本研究对全球创新体系中的技术变迁研究有所贡献，并限于技术扩散渠道，为前沿技术治理提供了政策启示。
title: Cross-Border Venture Capital in the Semiconductor Industry: Knowledge Spillover or Capital Deepening?
title_zh: 半导体行业中的跨境风险投资：知识溢出还是资本深化？

abstract: Mobile insurance is gaining increasing popularity in the global insurance industry. Using a unique data of a best-selling mobile cancer insurance product from a Chinese life insurer, this paper studies the relationship between mobile technology and insurance inclusion. We find that the introduction of the mobile application channel disproportionately increases the take-up of low-insured-amount policies relative to high-insured-amount policies. This inclusive effect toward small policies is driven mainly by newly attracted enrollees with lower-income characteristics. Mechanism analyses show that the mobile application channel reduces transaction costs and weakens offline intermediation frictions that otherwise disadvantage low-insured-amount customers. However, mobile insurance inclusion is regionally unequal due to the digital divide—it is stronger in more developed areas. We also find that the inclusive effect extends beyond policy take-up to after-purchase outcomes including claim and indemnity, thereby improving the welfare of low-insured-amount policyholders.

abstract: This study examines spurious fixed-effects (FE) regressions in large-N, small-T panels. We derive the fixed-T, large-N behavior of one-way and two-way FE estimators and their conventional and cluster-robust t-statistics under different random-walk processes and provide supporting Monte Carlo evidence. Two-way FE models with cluster-robust standard errors (SEs) do not exhibit a substantially higher risk of spurious regressions under pure random walks or random walks with homogeneous drift. In the correlated heterogeneous drift case, however, the risk of spurious inference can be substantial even with cluster-robust SEs. This risk increases with both T and N, but remains non-negligible even when T=5.
title: A Note on Spurious Regressions in Fixed Effects Models
title_zh: 关于固定效应模型中伪回归的注记

abstract: This paper provides quasi-experimental evidence on the effects of information access in centralized college admissions. Using administrative data, we exploit a batched dynamic matching mechanism in the Chinese province of Inner Mongolia to compare students just above and below batch cutoffs. Once higher-scoring students have finalized their choices, those just below the cutoffs gain additional information that helps them identify the set of feasible colleges. As a result, they are more likely to apply to reach options and are admitted to more selective colleges. The effects are strongest near batch cutoffs where information access matters most.

abstract: How to manage harvest and storage of agricultural products has been one of the long‐lasting questions in agricultural economics. We study the value of improved forecast accuracy for the producers in the context of intra‐seasonal supply allocation, particularly for specialty crops with multiple harvest cycles within a season. We first explore how the forecast accuracy affects intra‐seasonal storage decisions. We then derive the expression for the marginal value of the improved forecast accuracy and show that the gains from the improvement in the forecast accuracy occur by shifting the optimal storage choices to those under certainty (i.e., the state is revealed) from those under uncertainty. Finally, we provide numerical illustrations on how the value of the improved forecast accuracy for the producers differs across different degrees of market power showing that relative gains from the improvement are larger when the market is more competitive. We conclude by drawing broader implications highlighting the importance of the interaction among information, storage and market structure.
abstract_zh: 如何管理农产品的收获与储存一直是农业经济学中长期存在的问题之一。本文研究在季内供给配置背景下，尤其是对在一个季节内具有多个收获周期的特色作物而言，提高预测精度对生产者所具有的价值。我们首先探讨预测精度如何影响季内储存决策。随后，我们推导出预测精度提高的边际价值表达式，并表明预测精度提高所带来的收益，是通过将最优储存选择从不确定性下的选择转向确定性下（即状态被揭示）的选择而实现的。最后，我们提供数值示例，说明预测精度提高对生产者的价值如何随不同程度的市场势力而变化，表明当市场更具竞争性时，预测精度提高所带来的相对收益更大。我们最后给出更广泛的启示，强调信息、储存与市场结构之间相互作用的重要性。
title: On the Value of Improved Forecasting for Specialty Crop Producers Through Intra‐Season Supply Allocations

abstract: The Chinese government considers achieving an energy transition from traditional biofuels to modern energy as one of its major rural development and environmental protection goals. However, the transition faces challenges from the population ageing trend. This article examines how ageing influences household cooking fuel use in rural China. It builds a theoretical framework that takes preference differences and bargaining between elderly and non-elderly adults into account and tests the hypotheses derived from this framework using survey data collected in rural central China in 2021. The empirical results suggest that ageing households consume less energy for cooking. Households with a larger share of elderly in the household spend less on modern cooking energy but more on commercial firewood, due to the lower affordability but higher preference for traditional energy of the elderly. Saving preference can reduce household modern energy consumption but exhibits intergenerational transmission characteristics. These results signal that the rural energy transition will still be a long-term program. Diversifying the livelihood choices and lower risk expectations of ageing households could contribute to rural energy transition.

abstract: This paper examines how sibship size affects children’s cognitive and non-cognitive skills using data from the China Family Panel Studies (CFPS). To obtain the causal effect of sibship size on child development, we use first-born twins as an instrumental variable for sibship size and find that a larger sibship size significantly reduces children’s literacy and maths test scores, but alleviates depressive symptoms. When examining the potential channels behind the estimated effects, we find that having more siblings reduces educational expenditure on children and lowers their educational expectations, while prompting children to seek emotional support from their siblings, which suggests that sibship size weakens children’s cognitive skills mainly through resource dilution and alleviates children’s depressive symptoms largely through sibling interaction. Furthermore, we find that the effect of sibship size on child development varies by hukou status, household economic status, school quality, and child gender.

abstract: High-income professionals such as physicians allocate their portfolios as if financial markets were an unsolved lemons market. In the pooled 2022-2024 Survey of Income and Program Participation (5,279 observations, seven occupations), physicians hold about half their financial assets in passive retirement accounts and a tenth in equity mutual funds, against 13 percent for software developers. Of three channels of occupational proximity to finance, formal financial education, coworker exposure, and quantitative-digital fluency, only fluency predicts equity participation; years of education carry no positive association, despite substantial within-occupation variation. The estimates are conditional associations, not causal effects; they survive demographic controls, alternative clustering, and a time-preference proxy. A lemons market model in which institutional solutions to asymmetric information exist but go unobserved accounts for the pattern: agents who do not see the solution withdraw into consumption, transparent assets, or costly delegation. An accounting decomposition places the associated wealth gap at 29 percent of terminal wealth, mostly advisory fees and reduced saving. The mechanism parallels vaccine hesitancy: a physician who cannot evaluate the SEC behaves like a parent who cannot evaluate the FDA. Financial education should target institutional awareness, or credible reassurance where distrust rather than unawareness binds, instead of compound interest.p<0.001
title: Doctor, heal thy portfolio: asymmetric information and equity market participation among High-Income professionals
title_zh: 医生，治愈你的投资组合：高收入专业人士中的信息不对称与股市参与

abstract: This book argues that the story of opioids in modern world history did not begin with the American OxyContin crisis of the 1990s, and that this story cannot be told entirely as one of prohibition, crime, and smuggling.The core of the book is a narrative of the attempts of the Ottoman, Turkish, and Indian governments to negotiate a role for their opium growing and processing sectors in an international system that tried to restrict opiates to 'legitimate' channels, especially after the system was dominated by the Americans after World War II.This requires the author to draw on sources from several archives and touch on aspects of scientific, diplomatic, economic, social, and political history.It is also a surprisingly personal history.Siegel follows Ottoman opium brokers, St. Louis chemists, Indian bureaucrats, Turkish politicians, American drug crusaders, and others whose individual stories enliven the narrative whilst also showing how the drug business remained contingent and based on ethical factors and local relationships no matter how much governments tried to turn it into a fully rational, bureaucratic, and marketized system.Turkey, and its chief rival, India, had long histories as producers of opium.Prior to 1945, India sent much of its production to the colonial opium monopolies of Asia (not discussed in this book), and Turkey was the chief supplier of raw opium to the European dominated pharmaceutical industry.In each place, governments had been working to impose greater legibility and control on their systems, both to guarantee profits and to ensure the emerging international drug control system, exemplified by the 1925 Geneva Opium Convention, that their production was not being diverted into illicit channels.After 1945, the United States became the dominant producer and consumer of medical opioids and also the dominant power in the international drug control system.A system of managed trade developed, with India and Turkey trying to keep a market that supported thousands of their farmers, and the Americans trying to control production of raw opium, which might be diverted All rights reserved, including rights for text and data mining and training of artificial intelligence technologies or similar technologies.

abstract: In this paper, I estimate discrete choice models for the joint selection of handsets and mobile tariffs, using data on 10,738 subscribers of a European mobile telecommunications operator observed between April 2011 and December 2014. The estimates are used to compute an attention weight on future recurring tariff payments, measured relative to the upfront handset cost. I interpret this weight as a ‘revealed‐choice’ measure of consumer myopia. The results show that consumers substantially underweight future costs on average, with heterogeneity across consumer groups and, more importantly, over time. The average attention weight increases sharply during the period studied, coinciding with the diffusion of SIM‐only tariffs and the entry of a new competitor. These market changes affected prices and variety, but also increased the salience and transparency of total contract costs. Counterfactual simulations show that consumer welfare gains come from both the decline in tariff prices and the availability of SIM‐only offers. The price decline accounts for a large share of the gains, while SIM‐only tariffs provide additional welfare gains by expanding the choice set. Comparing the estimated attention weights with a full‐attention benchmark further shows that consumer underattention shapes predicted choices.
abstract_zh: 本文利用一家欧洲移动通信运营商在2011年4月至2014年12月期间观察到的10738名用户数据，估计了手机与移动资费联合选择的离散选择模型。基于估计结果，我计算了消费者对未来经常性资费支付的关注权重，该权重以手机 upfront 成本为参照进行衡量。我将这一权重解释为消费者短视的“显示性偏好”度量。结果表明，消费者平均而言显著低估未来成本，且这种低估在不同消费者群体之间存在异质性，更重要的是，随时间而变化。在研究期间，平均关注权重急剧上升，这与仅SIM卡资费的扩散以及新竞争者的进入相吻合。这些市场变化影响了价格和多样性，但也提高了合同总成本的显著性和透明度。反事实模拟显示，消费者福利收益既来自资费价格的下降，也来自仅SIM卡套餐的可获得性。价格下降解释了收益的很大一部分，而仅SIM卡资费通过扩大选择集提供了额外的福利收益。将估计的关注权重与完全关注基准进行比较进一步表明，消费者的关注不足会塑造预测选择。
title: Are Consumers Myopic? Evidence from Handset and Mobile Services Choices
title_zh: 消费者是短视的吗？来自手机和移动服务选择的证据

abstract: Against the backdrop of global climate governance, the impact of Energy Transition Policies (ETPs) on corporate sustainability has become a key concern for both academia and policymakers. Drawing on a sample of Chinese A-share listed companies from 2009 to 2022 and using the New Energy Demonstration City Policy as a quasi-natural experiment, this study empirically examines the impact of ETPs on corporate sustainability and their underlying mechanisms. The results indicate that ETPs have a positive effect on corporate sustainability, primarily through three channels: Eased financing constraints, green technological innovation, and digital transformation. Moderation analysis reveals that sound corporate governance structures and lower levels of external institutional uncertainty both positively moderate the implementation effects of these policies. Heterogeneity analysis suggests that the aforementioned policy effects are more pronounced in the Northeast and North regions, as well as in heavily polluting and technology-intensive industries. Further analysis shows that the policy significantly enhances corporate environmental performance and governance standards, while also narrowing ESG gaps to some extent. Moreover, the policy’s effect on ESG performance is more pronounced for corporations in the lower quantiles of the ESG distribution. This study provides empirical support for optimising ETPs instruments and establishing a differentiated policy framework tailored to local conditions, whilst offering strategic guidance for corporations to capitalise on transition opportunities and enhance their sustainability capabilities.
abstract_zh: 在全球气候治理背景下，能源转型政策（ETPs）对企业可持续发展的影响已成为学术界和政策制定者关注的重点。本文以2009—2022年中国A股上市公司为样本，以新能源示范城市政策为准自然实验，实证检验了能源转型政策对企业可持续发展的影响及其内在机制。结果表明，能源转型政策对企业可持续发展具有正向促进作用，主要通过缓解融资约束、绿色技术创新和数字化转型三条渠道实现。调节效应分析发现，良好的公司治理结构和较低的外部制度不确定性均对政策实施效果具有正向调节作用。异质性分析表明，上述政策效应在东北和华北地区，以及重污染行业和技术密集型行业中更为显著。进一步分析发现，该政策显著提升了企业环境绩效和治理水平，同时在一定程度上缩小了ESG差距。此外，该政策对ESG表现的影响在ESG分布较低分位数的企业中更为显著。本研究为优化能源转型政策工具、建立因地制宜的差异化政策框架提供了经验支持，同时为企业把握转型机遇、提升可持续发展能力提供了战略指引。

abstract: Consumer price inflation is conventionally measured at a monthly or quarterly frequency. However, the increased availability of electronic point-of-sale data (scanner data) raises the possibility of constructing indexes at higher frequencies, such as weekly. This is likely to benefit many users, such as central banks, who closely follow consumer price trends. A key challenge in building high frequency weekly price indexes is intertemporal substitution. The dependence of current expenditures on past prices can introduce bias into the index. The paper proposes a novel solution to address this problem. We construct low frequency cost-of-living comparisons between two spans of weeks. Then show how to identify high-frequency weekly price changes from these low frequency multi-week price comparisons. Our approach to constructing weekly indexes is illustrated using a large US scanner data set from 2006 to 2020. We find modest increases in the variability of weekly compared with monthly indexes. Our results highlight that high frequency weekly indexes can be readily constructed in practice and that they are likely to provide new insights to policymakers.
abstract_zh: 消费者价格通胀通常按月或按季度频率衡量。然而，电子销售点数据（扫描数据）可得性的提高，使得构建更高频率（如周度）指数的可能性增加。这可能使许多用户受益，例如密切关注消费者价格趋势的中央银行。构建高频周度价格指数的一个关键挑战是跨期替代。当前支出对过去价格的依赖可能会给指数带来偏误。本文提出了一种新颖的解决方案来处理这一问题。我们构建了两个周度区间之间的低频生活成本比较。然后展示如何从这些低频多周价格比较中识别高频周度价格变化。我们使用2006年至2020年的大型美国扫描数据集来说明构建周度指数的方法。我们发现，与月度指数相比，周度指数的变异性仅温和上升。我们的结果突出表明，高频周度指数在实践中可以 readily 构建，并且很可能为政策制定者提供新的洞见。

abstract: I study how bankruptcy law firm advertisements affect household credit, exploiting the borders of local TV advertisement media markets. I document a significant advertising effect on filing rates and subsequently show that ad exposure is associated with better financial outcomes. I then characterize how ad-induced filers are different from existing filers in terms of case, financial, and credit variables. I find that ad-induced filers are more likely to receive a discharge, file with lawyer representation, and be first-time filers. I interpret these findings as evidence that bankruptcy law firm advertisements help mitigate frictions in the bankruptcy decision.
abstract_zh: 我研究破产律师事务所广告如何影响家庭信贷，利用地方电视广告媒体市场的边界进行识别。我记录了广告对申请率的显著影响，并随后表明广告接触与更好的财务结果相关。接着，我刻画了广告引致的申请人与现有申请人在案件、财务和信贷变量方面的差异。我发现，广告引致的申请人更有可能获得债务免除、有律师代理申请，并且是首次申请者。我将这些发现解释为破产律师事务所广告有助于缓解破产决策中摩擦的证据。
title: Bankruptcy lawyers and credit recovery
title_zh: 破产律师与信贷回收

abstract: The symbolic meanings of money play a critical role in people's lives, influencing economic practices, relationships, work motivation, and financial well-being. Despite a substantial literature in the psychology of money, no instrument has comprehensively measured the full range of symbolic meanings associated to money. This research aims to validate a novel instrument designed to investigate the symbolic dimensions of money, drawing upon a solid theoretical framework grounded in psychodynamic theory. The theory of Monetary Styles represents one of the first attempts to comprehensively account for the heterogeneity and diversity of money's symbolic significance. This framework distinguishes six monetary styles, patterns of relating to money that arise from its symbolic meanings and manifest in distinct behaviors and values. Based on this framework, the Monetary Styles Questionnaire was developed and validated across six studies. The findings showed psychometric robustness, validity over time, and reliability in both Italy and the U.S. Results further supported the theoretical framework by revealing meaningful associations between monetary styles and relevant constructs, including financial practices and work-related motivations. In addition to advancing theory and providing a new tool for measuring the symbolic meaning of money, this research offers significant implications for practitioners, educators, and policymakers seeking to foster healthier financial behaviors and economic well-being at both individual and societal levels.
abstract_zh: 金钱的象征意义在人们的生活中发挥着关键作用，影响着经济实践、人际关系、工作动机以及财务福祉。尽管金钱心理学已有大量文献，但尚无工具全面测量与金钱相关的象征意义之全部范围。本研究旨在验证一种新型测量工具，该工具基于以心理动力学理论为基础的坚实理论框架，用以考察金钱的象征维度。金钱风格理论是首批尝试全面解释金钱象征意义之异质性与多样性的理论之一。该框架区分了六种金钱风格，即由金钱象征意义所引发、并表现为不同行为与价值观的与金钱发生关联的模式。基于这一框架，研究者开发了金钱风格问卷，并通过六项研究对其进行了验证。研究结果表明该问卷具有良好的心理测量学稳健性、跨时间的效度，以及在意大利和美国两地的信度。结果还通过揭示金钱风格与相关构念（包括财务实践和工作相关动机）之间存在有意义的关联，进一步支持了该理论框架。除了推进理论并为测量金钱的象征意义提供新工具外，本研究还为致力于在个体与社会层面促进更健康的财务行为和经济效益的从业者、教育者和政策制定者提供了重要启示。
title: Unveiling the symbolic relationship with money: The validation of the monetary styles questionnaire
title_zh: 揭示与金钱的象征关系：货币风格问卷的验证

abstract: We study school switches in which students who have already been assigned seats request reassignment. Unlike in regular school choice, stability need not be legally binding in such programs, since students’ priority-based claims have already been satisfied upstream. Efficiency then naturally becomes the primary design objective. To quantify the potential legal efficiency gains, we compare Deferred Acceptance (DA) with Top Trading Cycles (TTC) and an efficiency-adjusted DA (EADAM) using Swedish data. TTC and EADAM triple switching rates compared to DA. This difference is driven by the absence of slack in effective capacity and shrinks rapidly when introducing additional seats.
abstract_zh: 我们研究学校转学问题，即已被分配学位的学生请求重新分配。与常规学校选择不同，在此类项目中，稳定性不必具有法律约束力，因为学生基于优先权的诉求已在上游得到满足。因此，效率自然成为首要设计目标。为量化潜在的法律效率收益，我们使用瑞典数据，将延迟接受机制（DA）与最高交易循环机制（TTC）以及效率调整型延迟接受机制（EADAM）进行比较。与DA相比，TTC和EADAM使转学率提高了两倍。这一差异源于有效容量缺乏冗余，并且在引入额外学位后会迅速缩小。
title: Unlocking legal efficiency gains in school switch programs
title_zh: 释放学校转换项目中的法律效率收益

abstract: Many modern organizations use knowledge hierarchies, where frontline workers try to resolve tasks and pass those they cannot resolve to experts. But the implications of this organization of expertise are not well understood, especially if firm revenues depend on who resolves each task or the firm generates downstream externalities. We study a knowledge hierarchy (KH) using 500,000 patient cases from an online primary care firm, linked to outcomes and costs across Sweden's healthcare system. We use variation in assignment arising from temporary doctor congestion, controlling for date-by-three-hour windows and flexible case characteristics. Within the KH, nurses resolve 70% of cases and pass the remainder to doctors. Relative to doctor-only care, the KH modestly increases external primary care and ED visits but has no adverse effects on hospitalizations, earnings losses, or mortality. Although the mean effect of KH on systemwide (firm plus downstream) production costs is small, this masks substantial heterogeneity. Compared to using only doctors, the savings from the firm's selective use of the KH equal 1.6% of online primary care costs. However, our main finding is that reassigning cases between the direct-to-doctor and KH routes within 15-minute windows to minimize systemwide production costs would save 6.8% of online primary care costs.
abstract_zh: 许多现代组织采用知识层级结构，即一线工作者尝试解决任务，并将无法解决的任务转交给专家。但这种专业分工组织方式的影响尚未被充分理解，尤其是当企业收入取决于由谁解决每项任务，或企业会产生下游外部性时。我们利用一家在线初级保健机构的50万份患者病例，并将其与瑞典整个医疗系统的结局和成本数据相关联，研究了一种知识层级结构（KH）。我们利用因医生临时拥堵而产生的分配变异，并控制日期—三小时时间窗口以及灵活的案件特征。在该知识层级结构中，护士解决了70%的病例，并将其余病例转交给医生。相对于仅由医生提供照护，知识层级结构适度增加了外部初级保健和急诊就诊，但对住院、收入损失或死亡率没有不利影响。尽管知识层级结构对全系统（企业加下游）生产成本的平均影响较小，但这掩盖了显著的异质性。与仅使用医生相比，企业选择性使用知识层级结构所带来的节约相当于在线初级保健成本的1.6%。然而，我们的主要发现是，在15分钟窗口内，在直接就诊医生路径和知识层级结构路径之间重新分配病例，以最小化全系统生产成本，将节约在线初级保健成本的6.8%。
title: Organizing Expertise with Externalities: Evidence from Primary Care
title_zh: 组织具有外部性的专业知识：来自初级保健的证据

abstract: Climate-smart agricultural (CSA) practices are central to food-system decarbonisation, yet adoption often falls short of farmers’ stated intentions, weakening the impact of incentives and extension under capacity constraints. We test whether spatially targeted, AI-generated advice can narrow this intention-action gap in a randomised field experiment with 1529 row crop farmers in Iowa, Illinois and Indiana during the cover crop decision window. Farmers assigned to receive four AI-generated emails were 4.45 %age points more likely to plant cover crops than controls (z = 2.81, p = 0.005), despite high baseline intentions in both groups. Effects operated on the extensive margin: there was no detectable change in the share of land planted among adopters. Survey responses indicate high engagement and a shift from untested optimism to more calibrated trust after exposure. Supervised AI advice can provide a low-cost, scalable complement to existing extension, improving follow-through and modestly expanding uptake without displacing human expertise.
abstract_zh: 气候智慧型农业（CSA）实践是食品系统脱碳的核心，但其采用率往往低于农民所表达的意思，在能力约束下削弱了激励措施和推广服务的效果。我们在爱荷华州、伊利诺伊州和印第安纳州的覆盖作物决策窗口期，对1529名大田作物农民开展了一项随机田间试验，检验空间靶向、AI生成的建议能否缩小这一意愿—行动差距。被分配接收四封AI生成电子邮件的农民，其种植覆盖作物的可能性比对照组高4.45个百分点（z = 2.81，p = 0.005），尽管两组基线意愿均较高。效应作用于广延边际：在采用者中，未检测到种植土地份额的变化。调查回应表明参与度较高，且在接触建议后，农民从未经检验的乐观转向更为校准的信任。监督式AI建议可作为现有推广服务的低成本、可扩展补充，改善后续落实并适度扩大采用，而不会取代人类专业知识。
title: AI-generated advice as a reinforcement layer in climate-smart agriculture
title_zh: 人工智能生成的建议作为气候智慧型农业中的强化层

abstract: Relationship lending refers to lending based on close bank–borrower relationships, expected to increase credit availability and support real economic activity. This paper proposes the ST‐B filter, a novel framework identifying significant ties in temporal bipartite networks. Applying our method to Japanese financial data (1977–2021), relationship lending comprises about 10%–35% of total lending and is associated with 33% larger loan volume than transaction lending. Our method uniquely enables the analysis of relationship lending using only transaction data, without requiring detailed information on bank–borrower relationships.
abstract_zh: 关系型贷款是指基于银行与借款人之间紧密关系而进行的贷款，预期能够提高信贷可得性并支持实体经济活动。本文提出ST-B过滤器，一种识别时序二分网络中显著关系纽带的新框架。将我们的方法应用于日本金融数据（1977—2021年），发现关系型贷款约占总贷款的10%—35%，且其贷款规模比交易型贷款大约33%。我们的方法独特之处在于，仅使用交易数据即可分析关系型贷款，而无需银行—借款人关系的详细信息。
journal: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
title: Identification of Relationship Lending in Bank–Borrower Networks
title_zh: 银行—借款人网络中关系型贷款的识别

abstract: During the energy crisis in 2022, electricity prices in Germany soared to unprecedented levels. To explore the drivers of the high electricity prices, we develop an electricity dispatch model that simulates hourly equilibrium prices under the assumption of perfect competition. We then extend this model to account for firms exercising market power. By comparing the outcomes of the perfect competition and Cournot competition models with actual market data, we demonstrate that market power may have contributed to higher prices during the crisis, elevating them beyond what rising input costs alone would justify.
abstract_zh: 在2022年能源危机期间，德国电价飙升至前所未有的水平。为探究高电价的驱动因素，我们构建了一个电力调度模型，在完全竞争假设下模拟小时均衡价格。随后，我们将该模型扩展至考虑企业行使市场势力的情形。通过将完全竞争模型和古诺竞争模型的结果与实际市场数据进行对比，我们表明市场势力可能助推了危机期间的价格上涨，使其超出仅由投入成本上升所能解释的水平。
title: Electricity prices during the energy crisis in Germany: The role of market power
title_zh: 德国能源危机期间的电力价格：市场势力的作用

abstract: We conduct a large-scale, randomized controlled trial of a six-month intervention combining intensive mentoring and group cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) for youth in Chicago, following study participants for up to five years. The program was designed to engage young people at higher risk of involvement with the criminal justice system, and successfully did so with a take-up rate of 62%. Participants averaged 177 hours with mentors and nine hours of group CBT. After 24 months, youth offered the program experienced a 19% reduction in the probability of being arrested. Notably, this impact persists into adulthood, as effects remain stable through five years post-randomization. A reduction in arrests for violent offenses is driving this overall arrest reduction, with a 23% reduction in the probability of a violent-crime arrest after 24 months. The program does not impact school enrollment persistence (graduation or being enrolled), but shows suggestive improvements in school behavior and school mobility. We conclude that programs that combine mentoring and CBT can serve as a model for engaging a harder-to-reach population of youth, and can be effective in reducing criminal justice contact in the longer run.
title: Long-term impacts of youth mentoring and therapy: Experimental evidence from Chicago
title_zh: 青年指导与治疗的长期影响：来自芝加哥的实验证据

abstract: Established behavioral insights may not generalize when applied to under-represented target populations. Iterative approaches that identify such external validity failures to guide policy deployment at scale and to inform subsequent design refinements gain importance. We implement this approach in a field experiment involving 1800 low-income households in one of the largest energy efficiency assistance programs. Despite extensive co-designed vetting, most behavioral insights proved ineffective or inefficient. Notably, loss-framed interventions backfired by reducing take-up. We rank insights by their Marginal Value of Public Funds (MVPF), identifying ‘unexpected winners’ that outperform alternatives rated as promising by experts and laypeople. Our analysis suggests that factors specific to low-income households, such as scarcity, fundamentally alter behavioral responses, necessitating guided deployment to optimize future public assistance design.
title: Transporting behavioral insights to low-income households: A field experiment on energy efficiency investments
title_zh: 将行为洞察传递给低收入家庭：能源效率投资的实地实验

abstract: Accelerating the energy transition is pivotal to achieving sustainable economic development, yet localized environmental policies can profoundly reshape the spatial allocation of corporate capital. The impact of place-based energy transition policies on firms' cross-regional investment remains largely unexplored. Existing studies primarily examine the environmental and economic consequences of such policies, while paying limited attention to their influence on firms' geographic expansion strategies. Using a sample of Chinese A-share listed firms from 2006 to 2022, we examine whether and how the New Energy Demonstration City (NEDC) pilot policy affects corporate cross-regional investment (CORI). We find that the NEDC policy significantly increases firms' CORI, indicating that firms located in pilot cities expand more actively beyond their home provinces. This finding is consistent with the resource-based view. We further find that this effect is stronger for non-state-owned firms, non-heavy-polluting firms, and firms audited by the Big Four, and remains robust to a series of robustness and endogeneity tests. Mechanism analyses show that the NEDC policy promotes CORI by reducing information asymmetry and lowering corporate risk-taking. These findings suggest that place-based energy transition policies reshape firms’ geographic allocation of resources and provide new evidence on how policy-induced environmental change affects corporate investment decisions.
china_relevance_reason: 使用2006-2022年中国A股上市公司样本，研究中国新能源汽车示范城市政策对企业跨区域投资的影响，研究对象、数据与政策背景均为中国。
title: Energy transition and corporate geographic expansion
title_zh: 能源转型与企业地理扩张

abstract: Embedded in the value of a statistical life (VSL) is a stream of valuations of each expected year of life. The value of a statistical life year (VSLY) has a policy-relevant role analogous to the VSL, except that it monetizes risks to short periods of life extension. This article reviews previous studies and reports new labor market estimates of the average VSLY and the variation of these values with age using two methods—inferring the average VSLY based on estimates of the VSL and a new method that provides direct empirical estimates of the valuation of a discounted life year. The direct estimates of the VSLY yield larger values than the constructed estimates. The VSLY based on fatality rates by industry and occupation is $600,000 to $800,000 at a 3% interest rate. Estimates based on age-adjusted fatality rates are somewhat lower. The discount rate used in assessing the VSLY has a pivotal effect on the estimated VSLY. The VSLY is substantially lower in the absence of discounting and more than doubled at a discount rate of 10%. Failure to use a positive discount rate greatly understates the VSLY. The article also reviews previous VSLY studies as well as estimates of the discount rate for years of life expectancy.
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: The value of a statistical life year
title_zh: 统计生命年的价值

abstract: We find that the effect of political connections on tax planning depends on firms’ financial conditions. After increased political connections, financially unconstrained firms increase tax planning and spending on tax services, as documented in prior studies, whereas constrained firms decrease tax planning and spending on tax services. Moreover, decreases in tax planning are only present for constrained firms that obtain new bank loans and public debt and when the connected politicians serve on banking-related committees. Our results suggest that by facilitating access to external financing, political connections reduce financially constrained firms’ use of tax planning as an internal financing tool.
journal: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis
title: Political Connections, Financial Constraints, and Corporate Taxation
title_zh: 政治关联、融资约束与企业税收

abstract: We examine whether and how firms use connected social media outlets to counteract negative coverage in traditional media. Employing a sample of Chinese listed firms with ties to social media outlets, we find that connected outlets portray firms more favorably than unconnected ones. Following unfavorable coverage in traditional media, connected outlets shift attention toward long-term prospects and promote favorable narratives, consistent with an optimism-shifting mechanism. The effect is more pronounced when firms have stronger incentives to stabilize stock prices and when managers face heightened career concerns. Our findings highlight the role of connected social media outlets in shaping corporate narratives.
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为中国上市公司，数据样本明确为中国上市企业，核心应用和制度背景是中国。
journal: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis
title: Connected Social Media
title_zh: 互联社交媒体

abstract: This study presents results from a randomized controlled trial in Switzerland that investigates the effects of a non-monetary intervention on transport choices. A GPS-based tracking app records the movements of 814 participants for several months, and automatically detects their travel modes. The treatment consists of sending personalized transport reports to a randomly selected subgroup. These reports contain personalized descriptive and prescriptive information on participants’ transport-related external costs. The treatment reduces the external costs of transport by 12.4%, but only on weekends, and only during the first half of the study. In the second half, the effect dissipates to zero. Based on participants’ travel response and their willingness-to-pay for future reports, we estimate average gross welfare gains of 1.6–3.6 Swiss francs per participant per week in the short run. Of this, 0.8–2.8 Swiss francs reflect the private value of the reports rather than the temporary behavioral change.
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
title: Reducing transport externalities through nudging: Results from a GPS-tracked experiment
title_zh: 通过助推减少交通外部性：基于GPS追踪实验的结果

abstract: We evaluate the labor market effects of an increasing supply of high-skilled labor, resulting from a higher education expansion at established German universities. Exploiting variation in exposure across regions and cohorts, we estimate early career effects for labor market entrants. We find that high-skilled wages decline initially, particularly in non-graduate jobs, but recover over the first 5 years of experience. For graduate job takers, we even report positive wage effects after 5 years. We explain the dynamics of the effects by the interplay of several mechanisms: immediate supply effects, recovery through regional mobility, and increased productivity of graduate jobs.
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Early career effects of entering the labor market during higher education expansion
title_zh: 高等教育扩张期间进入劳动力市场的早期职业效应

abstract: Aircraft payload capacity is a scarce operational resource jointly consumed by passenger body weight, non-tradable cabin and baseline baggage loads, and verified discretionary checked baggage; however, airline baggage policies typically allocate this capacity through uniform allowances and excess baggage fees. This study examines how such capacity can be allocated when passenger body weight is sensitive and privately known at the contracting stage, whereas checked baggage weight is verifiable at check-in. This study formulates a tradable payload-rights mechanism as a competitive-clearing market-design benchmark in which an airline defines the residual capacity available for verified discretionary checked baggage and passengers trade rights to carry baggage above a baseline allowance. A planner benchmark identifies the shadow price of the payload capacity. The main result establishes that under competitive trading, verifiable baggage, and market clearing, the equilibrium permit price decentralizes the planner’s benchmark allocation on the verified discretionary checked-baggage margin. The analysis separates allocative efficiency from incidence: the permit price governs the efficient allocation of scarce payload capacity, whereas the initial endowment of rights determines transfers among passengers and the division of scarcity rents between passengers and the airline. The analysis also considers implementation without direct pay-as-you-weigh pricing, emphasizing verification and settlement procedures that do not require direct body-weight reporting, airline revenue compatibility, and operational capacity shocks. The framework provides a market-design benchmark for implementing scarcity pricing on a verifiable checked-baggage margin when direct passenger-weight pricing is institutionally and socially constrained.
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Tradable payload rights under private passenger weight: a market-design approach to airline capacity allocation
title_zh: 私人乘客重量下的可交易载荷权：航空公司容量分配的市场设计方法

abstract: How firms generate and select ideas influences their strategic path and the development of entire industries. To better understand this process, we experimentally analyze the impact of knowledge on idea generation and selection in an incentivized ideation task. Between treatments, we vary whether or not ideators are provided with examples of previous successful ideas before working on the task. We provide causal evidence that knowledge about such example ideas leads to path dependencies, i.e., knowledge increases the similarity of new ideas to those provided. Consistent with the hypothesis that knowledge affects the search for new ideas, we find evidence of path dependencies during idea generation, but do not find statistically significant evidence of additional path dependencies during idea selection. Overall, when knowledge is provided, we observe an increase in selected innovative ideas that are similar to previous ideas and a decrease in selected innovative ideas that are different from previous ideas.
title: An Experimental Study on the Effect of Knowledge on Idea Generation and Idea Selection
title_zh: 知识对想法生成与想法选择影响的实验研究

abstract: We study the proportional division value in TU-games, which distributes the grand coalition worth in proportion to the players’ stand-alone worths. Focusing on fixed-population consistency, we characterize the proportional division value through three types of axioms: axioms concerning transformations of the grand coalition worth, composition axioms, and nullified-game consistency. The first type captures how payoffs respond when the grand coalition worth changes. The composition axioms require that the outcome be the same whether a game is solved directly or through a two-step procedure based on a reference allocation and an associated adjustment of the game. Nullified-game consistency requires that, when some players’ payoffs are fixed, the solution for the remaining players in the adjusted game coincides with their original payoffs. Together with efficiency and/or fairness-related conditions where appropriate, these axioms characterize the proportional division value.
title: Characterizations of proportional division value in TU-games via fixed-population consistency
title_zh: TU博弈中比例分配值的固定人口一致性刻画

abstract: Leveraging the unique setting of unilateral euroisation, this paper examines the spillover effects of euro area monetary policy on Montenegro and Kosovo. Through the lens of a structural VAR model with block exogeneity, it shows that euro area monetary policy shocks can significantly influence output and inflation in these economies, albeit with a delayed response, while contributing only modestly to their overall business cycle fluctuations.
title: ECB monetary policy transmission to unilaterally euroised economies
title_zh: 欧洲央行货币政策对单边欧元化经济体的传导

abstract: In comparative case studies that select a single control using a centered pre-treatment fit criterion, researchers report a difference-in-differences interval treating the selection as fixed. Under a Gaussian panel model with known covariance, a centered criterion yields exact naive intervals when the covariance is separable with a spherical time factor, for any cross-sectional covariance. Otherwise, given the selection and an independent residual, the estimator is truncated normal; the pivot yields exact selective coverage. In our simulations, naive coverage was often conservative and never materially below nominal; working-model plug-in inference exhibited modest undercoverage under strong serial correlation.
title: Exact inference after data-driven control-unit selection in difference-in-differences
title_zh: 双重差分中数据驱动控制单元选择后的精确推断
